validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="retry-count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="class" expr="'gold'"/>
    <data id="max.tries" expr="3"/>
    <data id="_total" expr="0"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="fail" cond="retry-count < 3" target="a">
      <assign location="retry-count" expr="retry-count + 1"/>
      <log label="retry" expr="'attempt ' + retry-count"/>
    </transition>
    <transition event="fail" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `retry-count` is not an ECMAScript identifier: it contains `-`
notes: the ECMAScript data model creates this variable (SCXML 1.0 §B.2.1) as a property of the global object, reachable only as `globalThis['retry-count']`; `retry-count` in an expression is not this variable: `-` subtracts, so `retry-count` reads two variables
diagnostics.help: to use the variable in expressions, name it with an identifier that is also an XML ID, such as `retryCount`, and rename every reference to it

fixes.message: rename the variable to `retryCount` here and in 4 references

diagnostics.message: `class` is an ECMAScript reserved word, not an identifier
notes: the ECMAScript data model creates this variable (SCXML 1.0 §B.2.1) as a property of the global object, reachable only as `globalThis['class']`; no expression or `<assign location>` can name it directly
diagnostics.help: to use the variable in expressions, name it with an identifier that is also an XML ID, such as `classValue`, and rename every reference to it

diagnostics.message: `max.tries` is not an ECMAScript identifier: it contains `.`
notes: the ECMAScript data model creates this variable (SCXML 1.0 §B.2.1) as a property of the global object, reachable only as `globalThis['max.tries']`; `max.tries` in an expression is a property access, not this variable
diagnostics.help: to use the variable in expressions, name it with an identifier that is also an XML ID, such as `maxTries`, and rename every reference to it

notes: SCXML reserves names that begin with `_` for system variables such as `_event`, `_sessionid`, `_name`, and `_ioprocessors`, and a conformant document declares no data with such an id
diagnostics.help: rename the data without the leading `_`, and update every reference to it

diagnostics.message: `location` is not an assignable ecmascript location: `retry-count` is not an ECMAScript variable name

secondary.message: declared here with a name that is not a variable name

notes: a location expression must name a place in the data model that can be assigned, such as a variable name or a property access like `a.b` or `a[0]`
diagnostics.help: `<data id="retry-count">` declares a variable no ECMAScript expression can name (`LINT015`): rename it, for example to `retryCount`, in its declaration and every reference
